# Scientific Research Papers MCP Server

> Scientific literature grounding MCP server for AI agents: unified search across 250M+ scholarly papers on arXiv, PubMed, OpenAlex, CrossRef, and Semantic Scholar.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx find-research-papers-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y find-research-papers-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://papers.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://papers.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `search_papers(query, sources, limit)`: Unified 5-source search.
- `get_paper(doi, id)`: Fetches paper abstract, DOI, and open-access PDF.
- `get_references(doi)`: Fetches paper references via CrossRef.
- `get_citations(doi)`: Fetches citing works via OpenAlex.
- `verify_paper(doi)`: Validates retraction flags and landing page.
- `list_sources()`: Returns status of all scholarly indexes.

## Environment Variables
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
